title: Recency of the Last Online Card Payment in the Active-Account Repayment Plan (School Nutrition Services Meal Account)
content:
## Rule

The repayment plan for active accounts's installments follow the School Nutrition Services Meal Account's last online card payment: one more (1) when the latest online card deposit on the account posted thirty days (30) or fewer before the quote date, counting the days from the deposit date to the quote date; one fewer (a change of -1) when the account shows no online card deposit or the latest posted more than sixty days (60) before the quote date; and no change otherwise.

## Day counts on both sides (hypothetical)

| Days from the latest online card deposit to the quote date | Change |
|---|---|
| 0 to 30 | one more |
| 31 to 60 | no change |
| 61 or more | one fewer (-1) |
| no online card deposit on the account | one fewer (-1) |

A latest online card deposit on October 1 and a quote date of October 31: 30 days, one more. A quote date of November 1: 31 days, no change. Deposits made in cash or by check at the register are not online card deposits and do not count.
